purpose: Move cyan spotlight source to top edge; preserve gold beam and disco ball.

Preserve the disco ball upper-right, its golden star glint, existing gold beam from upper-left, and the painterly colorful disco aesthetic. No new objects, no character, no crowd, no floor, no text.
